(() => {
  document.body.innerHTML = '<div id=keptName></div>' + '<div></div>'.repeat(400);
  const kept = document.getElementById('keptName');
  const detached = document.createElement('section');
  for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
    detached.innerHTML = '<span></span>';
    detached.id = 'detached' + i;
    detached.appendChild(document.createElement('i'));
    if (window.keptName !== kept || typeof window.missingDetachedName !== 'undefined') return false;
  }
  return true;
})()
